extraction_warnings: This paper reports cohort-level aggregate statistics (n=35 Swedish students) rather than per-subject or per-sample data; several schema fields intended for individual-level extraction (subject_id, sample_id, age as single value, sex as single value) could not be populated as such.

Two destination subgroups (Central Africa, n=17; Indian peninsula, n=18) exist and show some differing outcomes (e.g., ESBL acquisition, malaria prophylaxis use), but the schema fields requested do not include a proper destination/subcohort field, so this distinction was only noted in field notes.
DNA extraction kit and detailed subject-level identifiers were likely only available in supplemental tables (Table S1-S4) not provided in the given text.

PMID was not stated within the provided paper text body; only the external paper_id (26259788) was supplied by the task, which was not used as evidence since it does not appear in the paper text itself.
Age is reported only as a cohort-wide range (23-34 years), not per-subject or as mean; treated as study_level.
The 'disease' field was inferred as 'Healthy' since no disease/condition was mentioned for the study population of exchange students, but this is not an explicit statement in the text.

Many schema fields (zygosity, BMI, dietary restriction, HLA, neonatal/obgyn/tumor-related fields, smoking, treatment) are not applicable/reported in this travel-microbiome paper and were marked not_reported.

Schema fields (disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, tumor_size_measurement, etc.) appear designed for oncology studies and are not applicable to this microbiome/antibiotic resistance travel study; marked as not_reported.
biomarker_name/value/unit fields were repurposed to capture the antibiotic resistance gene fold-change findings, as no other clear 'biomarker' concept was present in the paper.
feces_phenotype_value has no direct correlate in the paper; marked not_reported with medium confidence due to ambiguous field intent.
